dedupe_keys.name: ковельська міська рада public transport datasets

description: Ковельська міська рада: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Ковельська міська рада. Coverage: Ковельська міська рада. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Розклад руху громадського транспорту; Відомості про транспортні засоби, які обслуговують пасажирські автобус; Дані про місце розміщення зупинок громадського транспорту. Formats seen: CSV, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
